nodes.label: FAILURE_REGISTRY.md
Hazard: Truncating writes to user files
nodes.rationale: Non-atomic truncating writes (e.g., ZipFile 'w' or ios::trunc) can destroy user config or archives if markers are missing.

nodes.label: Incident: Psi-amp CTD (Null Joint Array)
nodes.rationale: Exporting a motion-type subobject without joint-count metadata causes a null dereference in the model render walker.

nodes.label: Lesson: Squirrel Reserved Keywords
nodes.rationale: Using keywords like 'base' as identifiers fails the entire .nut compile, causing a cascade of missing helper functions.

nodes.label: Failure: Repeatedly 'fixed' things that weren't
nodes.rationale: User trust damage from unverified 'fixed' claims. Meta-failure: concluding a fix failed/succeeded without checking build identity (ss2vr.dll version/timestamp).

nodes.label: Failure: Weapon-mesh 'Matrix flicker'
nodes.rationale: Two CameraObj writers (WeaponProbeHandler vs stock viewmodel.nut) fighting for ownership. Fix failed because the mod was not in mod_path.

nodes.label: Failure: Chased 'framerate regression' in code
nodes.rationale: Root cause was Windows desktop refresh rate resetting to 50Hz, capping VR pipeline. gpuSpanMs is not a GPU-work metric.

nodes.label: Failure: Pausing live VR in x64dbg
nodes.rationale: Pausing freezes OpenXR submit and desyncs the automate bridge, causing crashes. Use DLL logger or Frida instead.

nodes.label: Failure: Echo suppressor wrote via trampoline
nodes.rationale: Trampoline bypasses OnConfigVarSet where DLL consumes vars (frob). Hooking core set handlers during load caused hard-hangs.

nodes.label: Failure: Equip-time hang (LGMD model-loader assert)
nodes.rationale: Game-side int3 assert on structural malformation (invalid element type) in BIN models. 'Parses cleanly' != 'Runtime safe'.

nodes.label: Failure: Recapturing authoritative display baseline during smooth turn
nodes.rationale: Repeated recapture baked HMD pitch/yaw into the baseline, causing horizon snaps and offset errors.

nodes.label: Failure: Treating object-direct yaw as stable transport
nodes.rationale: KEX restores/rebases yaw and pitch from canonical paths (positionData), fighting direct writes. Pitch readback is at a different offset than the write target.

nodes.label: Failure: Compacting LGMD BSP nodes without remapping
nodes.rationale: Shrinking node records without remapping child offsets caused infinite traversal loops and game hangs.

nodes.label: ss2vr.dll
KEX Engine
OpenXR Runtime
Squirrel Scripts (.nut)
LGMD Model Loader
Failure: KEX config setter prologue mismatch
nodes.rationale: MinHook detour on FUN_1408d2c20 caused bridge prologue check to fail. Rule: Use trampoline if g_realSetConfigRaw is installed; use SEH-guarded call.

nodes.label: Failure: Pistol offhand parked default
nodes.rationale: Forcing Joint 3=2.0 froze pistol in slide-pull pose. Rule: Keep Joint 3=0.0 default; verify animations before tuning.

nodes.label: Failure: KPF backslash packing
nodes.rationale: Windows backslashes in KPF entries prevented Squirrel script loading. Rule: Use forward slashes only; verify with archive inspection.

nodes.label: Failure: Save-game mod table order
nodes.rationale: Incorrect load priority in save-game table prevented Squirrel manifest takeover. Rule: SS2VR must appear after sshock2ee (bottom of list).

nodes.label: Failure: Save header size prefix
nodes.rationale: Treated dword at 0x0 as absolute offset instead of FlatBuffer size prefix. Rule: Real body boundary is 4 + value.

nodes.label: Failure: AE Squirrel config read API
nodes.rationale: Used direct return-value APIs instead of ref-argument API. Rule: Use Engine.ConfigIsDefined with int_ref/float_ref.

nodes.label: Failure: FlatAim KPF extra root directory
nodes.rationale: Extra 'mod/' root prevented AE from finding squirrel.ini. Rule: Pack with root-level modinfo.json and sq_scripts/.

nodes.label: Failure: FlatAim KPF as tar instead of ZIP
nodes.rationale: KEX could not mount tar-style KPF. Rule: Use ZIP/PK format; verify with magic bytes 50 4B 03 04.

nodes.label: Failure: FlatAim canvas size authority
nodes.rationale: Used Win32 client size instead of Engine.GetCanvasSize(). Rule: Use height-normalized coordinates (540p) for ultrawide.

nodes.label: Failure: FlatAim cursor vs selection
nodes.rationale: Free-aim ray did not update native KEX selection. Rule: Use hover-candidate hook (FUN_1404b9a80) to inject pixels into KEX globals.

nodes.label: Failure: Hiding crosshair with opaque cover
nodes.rationale: Black square cover was visually intrusive. Rule: Target native Shock overlay (kOverlayCrosshair=22) instead of synthetic covers.

nodes.label: Failure: KexSetConfigRaw detour during save-load
nodes.rationale: Suspected cause of save-load crashes at 0x8D4700. Rule: Default config_hook=0; throttle Squirrel refreshes.

nodes.label: Failure: FlatAim F5 mode without bridge
nodes.rationale: Allowing F5 without Squirrel heartbeat caused diagnostic noise. Rule: block_without_bridge=1; deactivate if bridge goes stale.

nodes.label: Failure: Using Camera.GetFacing().x for projectile heading
nodes.rationale: Camera-facing heading was zero while body facing changed. Rule: Use ss2fa_projectile_mode=2 (offset native velocity).

nodes.label: Failure: Ray-cylinder semantic selector
nodes.rationale: 3D world ray distance caused surprising target hops. Rule: Use screen-projected comparison (selection_semantic_mode=2).

nodes.label: Failure: Judging mode 4 while clamped to mode 1
nodes.rationale: C++ code silently clamped modes > 3. Rule: Check range clamps before blaming config/scripts.

nodes.label: Failure: Proxy Object.Teleport facing order
nodes.rationale: Used CameraObj order (H/P/B) for world objects. Rule: Use vector(bank, pitch, heading) for Teleport.

nodes.label: Failure: Applying offsets as world heading/pitch
nodes.rationale: Caused pole pinch and player-facing dependency. Rule: Build aim in local view/native frame.

nodes.label: Failure: Shaded left-hand material bright white
nodes.rationale: Stale LGMD v4 material extras (off_mat_extra) fed garbage into Illumination/Color.a. Rule: Repair v4 material tail before packaging.

nodes.label: Failure: Preserving joint metadata on standalone hand
nodes.rationale: One-subobject LGMD with jointed root is unsafe in AE. Rule: Use static metadata (motion_type=0, joint_id=-1) for standalone probes.

nodes.label: Failure: Multi-material BIN with multi-pass material stack
nodes.rationale: Converter mishandles combination of 5-slot BIN and render_material_only stack. Rule: Iterate material complexity on single-material BINs.

nodes.label: Failure: Adding ini keys without whitelist update
nodes.rationale: DLL silently rejected keys not in hardcoded unordered_set. Rule: Update Config.h, parser, template, AND whitelist.

nodes.label: Failure: Compacting faces without aux records
nodes.rationale: Stale light/normal offsets caused crashes on equip. Rule: Compact face, node, light, and normal chunks together.

nodes.label: Failure: Assuming missing LGPMNM magic means no AE high-detail melee payload
nodes.rationale: Some held melee meshes use a second embedded wrapper with an LGMM marker followed by a short PMNM marker. Fixed in FunkMaxExport v0.6.31-pmnmwrap.

nodes.label: Failure: Pressing Funk Mesh on LGPMNM reference geometry
nodes.rationale: Funk Mesh is LGMD-only; LGPMNM reference nodes are not LGMD nodes and should not be handled by the LGMD-preserving writer. Fixed by adding a separate static export path.

nodes.label: Failure: LGPMNM snapshot export collected the same mesh twice
nodes.rationale: Selecting both the root and its mesh child caused duplicate collection and invalid self-sibling hierarchy. Fixed in v0.6.10-lgpmnmguard.

nodes.label: Failure: LGPMNM static vhots written in the wrong coordinate space
nodes.rationale: Vhot helpers inside the LGPMNM root should write authored local positions directly rather than being baked through the mesh parent transform again. Fixed in v0.6.42-sourcevhot.

nodes.label: Failure: Psi-amp cable custom export stored posed child vertices with preserved transform
nodes.rationale: Vertices were written in posed space while preserving non-identity transforms, causing double-transformation. Fixed by writing inverse-node-transform coordinates.

nodes.label: Failure: stale LGMD header vhot count crashes KEX loader
nodes.rationale: KEX sizes the runtime table from header byte 0x44; if this count is stale relative to the actual vhot chunk size, the engine crashes. Fixed in v0.6.25-vhotheader.

nodes.label: Failure: parser-clean shotgun vhot rebuild changed animated subobject identity/ranges
nodes.rationale: AE animations are sensitive to original subobject names and vertex ranges even if the BIN is parser-clean. Fixed by preserving stock subobject metadata during appends.

nodes.label: Failure: portal_relax=frontface — NOPing an exact geometric test
nodes.rationale: The test is an exact geometric invariant for portal BFS termination; NOPing it caused ClipAlloc pool exhaustion and distant cell culling.

nodes.label: Failure: dark_culling_profile — wrote to the wrong config system
nodes.rationale: Dark culling variables are legacy config vars in a linked list, not KEX cvars; writing them to kexengine.cfg is a no-op.

nodes.label: Failure: laser pistol offset back (-z) is NOT the model
nodes.rationale: The offset is caused by a missing VR grip pivot vhot (ID 2), causing the resolver to fall back to the muzzle vhot as the pivot.

nodes.label: Failure: EMP Rifle does no damage to Hybrids is vanilla-correct
nodes.rationale: EMP is anti-machine; Hybrids are organic fleshtargets with zero EMP vulnerability. This is canonical SS2 behavior, not a mod bug.
